name: AI-detector-generalization-benchmark
description: A benchmark that tests the generalization capability of AI-generated-text detectors across different generation methods and domains. It measures how well detectors trained on some models or domains can identify synthetic text from unseen models or shifts in content. The suite is aimed at evaluating robustness and cross-domain performance of detection methods.
reputation: A focused benchmark for detector generalization with limited but growing interest among researchers working on AI-generated text detection.
